meta.title: Validation gates and correlation method
meta.note: This is the compiler's own methodology. It is NOT a sourced fact. No gate has been run on real data, and no correlation value has been computed, because no verified odds or results dataset is available (see Flagged for Review).

gates.name: Legal review
gates.rule: Korean counsel must confirm in writing that the product and any public output do not fall under 국민체육진흥법 Art. 26 (see legal_kr.json) before anything is published for Korean users.
gates.why: Art. 26(2) prohibits designing or providing systems and game information for similar betting, and promoting or brokering it.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.rule: Odds and results must come from a named, documented source. Every row must link to that source.
gates.current_result: FAIL (no verified odds or results source)
gates.why: nba.com shows odds but the provider and values were not confirmed, so none were imported.

gates.name: Integrity screen
gates.rule: Drop any market the NBA restricts. Restriction status must be confirmed from an official NBA primary source, not from press reports.
gates.current_result: FAIL (restrictions are not yet confirmed from official primary text)

gates.name: Out-of-sample test
gates.rule: Parameters are fit on earlier dates only. Results are scored on later dates the model never saw. No look-ahead.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Require a minimum number of settled out-of-sample bets set in advance and written into this file before testing begins.
gates.why: No data. Threshold not yet set.

gates.name: Closing-line benchmark
gates.rule: Measure average difference from the closing price (CLV). Report it alongside results.

gates.name: Significance with multiple-testing correction
gates.rule: Test the one-sided p-value and correct for every strategy tried, not just the one being reported (for example Holm or Bonferroni). Report confidence intervals for ROI.

gates.name: Correlation and parlay independence
gates.rule: Before combining legs into a parlay or multi-leg bet, estimate the pairwise correlation of outcomes using only training-period data. Correlated legs are adjusted or excluded. Pairs are not treated as independent by default.

luck_control_note: No method removes variance. The gates above only reduce the chance of mistaking luck for skill. A strategy that passes can still lose money. Results need a long run to separate skill from luck.

correlation_table.rule: Pairwise correlations are estimated only from training-period data. Values are left blank until a verified dataset exists.
